<!-- CARD 1: LINEAR REGRESSION -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Linear Regression Thumbnail
x = np.array([60, 61, 65, 66, 67, 68, 70, 73, 74, 75])
y = np.array([110, 120, 155, 160, 164, 170, 178, 215, 223, 235])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.scatter(x, y, color='#1c528b', s=50)
m, b = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
ax.plot(x, m*x + b, color='#ed7953', linewidth=2.5) 
ax.axis('off') # Hides axes for a clean image look
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```
::: {.card-body}
<h5 class="card-title">Linear Regression Modeling</h5>
<p class="card-text">Predicting physical characteristics using math. An introduction to simple linear regression and plotting lines of best fit in Python.</p>

<!-- CARD 3: WEB SCRAPING -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Web Scraping Thumbnail (Network Nodes representing the web)
np.random.seed(42)
x_nodes = np.random.rand(15)
y_nodes = np.random.rand(15)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
for i in range(len(x_nodes)-1):
    ax.plot([x_nodes[i], x_nodes[i+1]], [y_nodes[i], y_nodes[i+1]], color='lightgrey', zorder=1)
ax.scatter(x_nodes, y_nodes, color='#ed7953', s=80, zorder=2)
ax.scatter(x_nodes[0], y_nodes[0], color='#1c528b', s=120, zorder=3) # Highlight starting node
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```
::: {.card-body}
<h5 class="card-title">Automating the Web</h5>
<p class="card-text">Introduction to web scraping and automation. Build a Python robot to navigate websites and extract image files using BeautifulSoup.</p>

<!-- CARD 4: RESONANCE DEFENDER GAME -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Game Waveform Thumbnail (Green/Red to match the game)
t = np.linspace(0, 4*np.pi, 100)
y1 = np.sin(t)
y2 = np.sin(t + np.pi/2)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.plot(t, y1, color='#10b981', linewidth=2.5)
ax.plot(t, y2, color='#ef4444', linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```
::: {.card-body}
